title: The Candy Rocket
summary: Three friends blast off in a ship made of cookies and candy, and up in space they find a little star who needs their help.

scenes.text: Lila, Tomi, and Sami were three friends who dreamed of flying. One Sunday, with lots of patience and lots of laughter, they built a spaceship made of cookies and candy. The walls were chocolate, the windows were sugar, and the buttons were colorful gummies. When everything was ready, the three friends climbed inside, hugged each other tight, and counted to three. The ship smelled of warm vanilla. Outside, the moon was waiting for them.

“Three, two, one!” they shouted together. The rocket lifted off and climbed up, up, up through the clouds. Whoosh! Soon the sky turned dark and soft like velvet, and thousands of stars appeared, twinkling everywhere. Lila laughed, Tomi pointed, and Sami floated like a feather. Space was huge and quiet, and everything smelled a little like candy. The three friends held hands. They had never seen anything so beautiful.

Suddenly, behind a comet, they found a very tiny little star. She was barely shining and had a sad little face. “What’s wrong?” asked Lila sweetly. The little star sighed: “I’m very, very hungry, and I have a bit of a sweet tooth. Without something sweet in my tummy, I can’t shine.” The three friends looked at each other and smiled, because their whole ship was made of yummy things. “Don’t worry,” said Tomi. “We’ll help you!”

Sami broke off a cookie from the ship’s door. Lila pulled a candy from a window. Tomi offered a gummy from a button. The little star took a slow bite: crunch! Then she tried the candy, then the gummy. All at once, she began to laugh with pure joy and to shine so brightly that she lit up all of space. “Thank you, friends!” she said, spinning happily. Never had a little star been so happy with a tummy full of sweets.

It was time to go back home. The grateful little star flew ahead of the ship to light the way back. They drifted down slowly through the clouds, with sleepy eyes and happy hearts. Lila, Tomi, and Sami snuggled up together and yawned a great big yawn. “Good night, little star,” they whispered. From the sky, she twinkled softly, as if saying good night too. And the three friends fell asleep, dreaming of new candy journeys.
